decision.scientific_information_flow: REC -> entered record -> TNOA -> downstream inference
decision.relationship: upstream record-entry counterpart, not successor replacement
decision.site_rule: show research lineage in the chapter path and scientific flow in the directed edge; do not collapse the two directions

tnoa.question: What observation state should be preserved once an observation has entered the scientific record?
tnoa.object: B + {T,N,U}, with separate target, nuisance, observability, attribution and optional independently validated absence evidence
tnoa.firewall: TNOA does not identify the biological composition of exposures that never entered the tested record and REC cannot retroactively alter TNOA Paper-1 frozen results

rec.owner: pre-entry exposure, acquisition, gate and archive/record-entry selection
rec.question: Which exposure opportunities or biological events never became usable records, why, and with what downstream ecological consequence?
rec.object: gate-independent exposure universe Omega, pre-gate evidence, acquisition/gate/entry states, reference-observable shadow set and reference-unresolved set
rec.status: open / active Paper-2 design and exploration programme
rec.firewall: REC studies worlds unseen by the tested record only when an independent exposure/reference design makes them auditable; it does not claim access to an unknowable biological world or completed field validation

mirror_rules: TNOA: low target support or not-target != biological absence
joint_decomposition: Where identifiable, REC Paper 2 may decompose upstream record-entry loss from downstream TNOA semantic coarsening on the same held-out evidence.
canonical_flow: latent process -> Omega -> REC acquisition/gate/entry -> entered record -> TNOA semantics -> ecological inference
non_transfer_rules: REC development does not modify TNOA D1-D5 results, thresholds, manuscript claims or submission package
TNOA post-entry information preservation does not prove that the entered record is an unbiased sample of biological exposure opportunities
an event log cannot serve as its own denominator for estimating events that never entered it
a master exposure ledger enumerates non-entry but independent reference truth is still required to identify biological composition of the shadow set
